# SHB local recovery assessment and replay

Authority: [SHB revision 1.1](../../014-Shop-SHB-Proposal-Revision-2026-10-30.md), including Appendix A. This continues existing12-01 after the verified [closing](shb-asic-closing-2026-11-02.md), [ordinary notice](shb-ordinary-notices-2026-11-02.md) and [material revision](shb-material-revisions-2026-11-02.md) slices. Results are local synthetic components; actual independent recovery qualification remains pending.

## Behavior

The existing disposable PostgreSQL access recovery gate now validates retained SHB records and local archives before releasing quarantine. Missing or inconsistent evidence refuses release with a fixed error and leaves access state unchanged. It reuses the existing offer, acceptance, observation, paid-order, closing and notice validators. It checks original invitation calendar expiry, customer associations, coupon snapshots/outcomes, source-bound ordinary notices and their deliveries/captures, and predecessor/closure links for changed ASIC work. Inspection does not use current prices or coupon/invitation validity to rewrite accepted facts.

Valid pending intents remain pending. The existing worker resumes an interrupted closing with its exact original identity, then applies its archived outcome once. A notice captured before worker loss resumes the original durable proof and envelope. Held/exhausted delivery remains held. An uncertain bank attempt remains lookup-only, with the original order and coupon association. No second payment or replacement reference is generated by inspection or local release.

`shop.shb.recovery.inspect_local_shb_recovery()` is internal, read-only and restricted to drained local/synthetic quarantine. The release transition uses the same checks under its epoch lock before invalidating access. There is no new HTTP route, worker, recovery platform, support-time ledger, balance API or task-email workflow.

Current files: [SHB assessment](../../backend/shop/shb/recovery.py), the existing [access recovery gate](../../backend/shop/access/recovery.py), [PostgreSQL recovery cases](../../backend/shop/shb/recovery_tests.py), both existing SHB test runners and [local recovery procedure](../local-recovery.md). Existing12-01 plan/context and PROJECT/STATE/ROADMAP/HANDOFF/machine routing are synchronized; no replacement master plan or schema migration is introduced.

## Evidence and limits

The actual [RED report](../evidence/shb/recovery-assessment-red-2026-11-02.json) records one PostgreSQL test after successful ordinary notice capture and quarantine. It fails because release does not raise after the captured proof blob is removed. GSD returns `RED_EVIDENCE_OK`; this assertion failure is the intended release gap, with no import, discovery or fixture failure. Test/state commit1009d97 is pushed.

Fourteen recovery cases pass: missing capture bytes, read-only inspection, unheld/undrained denial, missing delivery, a self-consistent forged recipient, missing applied closing bytes, interrupted closing after invitation revocation, committed capture before process loss, original month-end/leap-year clocks and coupon outcomes with selected-restore staff reset, missing replacement link, missing coupon reservation, uncertain bank reconciliation without a second start, held notice exhaustion, and a paid75-hour changed request retaining the original order and capture references.

The full shared lane passes **511 tests**, none failed or skipped:168 SHB,95 access/recovery,104 payment,30 staff review/navigation,24 worker/statement-mail,75 preserved transaction/archive,9 source/catalog and6 actual `unshare --net` adapter cases. Django check, additive migration application and migration-drift checks pass. [Regression/source record](../evidence/shb/retained-tests/6e939ae68314b7ad29d9808e2d279b38db0ad59464823f939864f724b1eec1ea.json) binds346 backend/eight-script hashes. An earlier168-case run found one corruption-fixture error because a second reservation trigger correctly rejected deletion; the fixture now explicitly controls both triggers only on its owned disposable table, with transactional rollback restoring them on error. Application SQL guards are unchanged.

Actual Chromium151.0.7922.173/Node24.15.0 passes **71 browser checks** in JavaScript/no-JavaScript modes at320px. Both modes complete a30-hour FPGA purchase, reviewed50-hour ASIC purchase, safe closing/withdrawal and linked unpaid75-hour request revision. [Browser/source record](../evidence/shb/retained-tests/598b59ebf0b542b9ccdcb641cafd9df2430d94736fbe4014720670e3137bd9b0.json) binds exactly the same346 backend/eight-script hashes as the511-test record. Private browser evidence: `.scratch/shb-checkout-browser-42ey7zdo`. The9-file private Astro release/manifest is unchanged. All owned test/browser/server/database contexts completed.

These checks cannot establish that all post-backup events were recovered. Missing sources and every associated record can disappear together; database consistency alone cannot prove completeness. The assessment therefore always reports `post_backup_completeness_established=false`, `actual_recovery_qualified=false`, `retry_authorized=false` and `reopening_authorized=false`. Pending counts expose retained work without attesting real delivery or money. Actual independent custody, external financial windows, post-backup reconstruction, restored revocations/MFA, traffic/egress isolation and off-host restore/complete-loss drills remain separate gates. The authorized independent runner is unassigned.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 scripts/check_shb_retained.py --shared
python3 scripts/check_shb_retained.py --browser --release .scratch/shb-private-resume-t2p3r5cc/release --browser-binary /nix/store/53p8msmqxpi829zdrw6qkvaamidxy9cj-chromium-151.0.7922.173/bin/chromium --browser-node /nix/store/5a8ysg1jnj8jmzzyfcfw7rvpvnp5rfpa-nodejs-24.15.0/bin/node
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_planning_activity.py'
python3 scripts/check_purchase_plan.py --refresh-inventory
python3 scripts/check_planning.py
python3 scripts/check_purchase_plan.py
```

The normal pinned lane remains `python3 scripts/check_shb.py --shared`; the retained-tool lane is separate synthetic evidence and does not qualify Nix/source/runtime/native/licence/OCI/CI or actual deployment. The new recovery test module is included in both lanes. Company inputs remain pending in the single [decision register](../decisions.md) and need no repeated request. No real bank/mail/storage/protected-host/DNS/TLS operation, production/bank-sandbox connection, `.env` access, cache modification or paid provision is part of this work. No parent SUMMARY, FULL_PASS or completion-count change is claimed.
